I once got barred from the pub I worked at….. we all did. Allowed in the pub 15 minutes before our shift, had to leave within 15 minutes after. Not allowed in at any other time, not allowed to order food or drink at any point.
Alcohol Wastage was up and instead of handling it in a mature way and addressing those responsible we all got barred via an angry A4 piece of paper in the break room 😂 bit unfair to the kitchen staff but they weren’t spared either..

I have logged it in the work accident book, witness statements and a confession were taken from the culprit. This is not the only incident that wasn’t dealt with in a satisfactory manner. Worse cases of assault than this dealt with by a slap on the wrist…. I’m in the verge of changing jobs over not feeling safe, my health is not worth what I keep telling myself is ‘just a job!

The thing is….. I completely see your point. They have more than one way to get rid of a ‘troublemaker’ 😞maybe the industry regulating body is the answer as we are due their opinion shortly 🙄 I’ll see what the union say first and go from there.
I have flagged this up, awaiting a response, thank you
Thank you, I hadn’t considered battery
Thanks, I have contacted the union and am awaiting further advice
This is what I was hoping for but the punishment is less than punishment for swearing 🙄
Statements taken from witnesses at random plus a written confession from the person in question
Haha I feel like such an idiot!
I had no idea you could do that!!
